meta.name: Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon Tokubetsu-hen
aliases: Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon Tokubetsu-hen
meta.description: As their big day draws closer, Miyo and Kiyoka feel their love deepening. And when Miyo attends a cooking class with Hazuki, she meets an old classmate!

videos.title: Special: Part 1
videos.overview: Miyo struggles to call Kiyoka by his first name as their wedding approaches. A cooking class introduces a familiar face who offers an unsettling "charm."

videos.title: Special: Part 2
videos.overview: Miyo informs Kiyoka about her curse. The Nagabas visit the Special Anti-Grotesquerie Unit for help — and a monstrous threat resurfaces before the wedding.

videos.title: Special: Part 3
videos.overview: Will Kiyoka make it to the wedding? Miyo holds firm as their long-awaited ceremony hangs in the balance. Their new chapter begins with unexpected turns.
